26.name: input26
26.text:
Appointment Guidelines:

For the sake of our collective safety and the sustainability of our space, we have limitations around how many shoppers the store can support at one time – we ask that you arrive a few minutes before or at the time you select below! 

If you are not present when your shopping appointment begins, you may need to wait to see whether or not it's possible for you to shop during another block of time. If there is no open availability in the other timeslot(s) you will need to make an appointment to shop the following Saturday instead.

You do not need to bring anything with you. If you need assistance shopping, let us know below and a volunteer will help you shop or have you fill out an assisted shop form. Young children who cannot be left unsupervised can shop with you. Any additional people will not be able to shop with you and will be asked to wait outside. Folks who would also like to shop will need to make their own appointment. You can also fill out this form with their info to make a separate appointment for them. They will not be able to shop without their own appointment/ticket.

Please note: Each individual can only sign up for one appointment. If you sign up for multiple appointments, we will select your earliest appointment time and remove the others.
